title: State of Punjab v. Davinder Singh

content.caseIdentity: State of Punjab v. Davinder Singh, 2024 INSC 562
content.holding: 7-judge Bench overruled E.V. Chinnaiah; held States have power to sub-classify within SCs/STs for preferential affirmative action based on empirical data, subject to creamy layer exclusion.
content.relevance: Permissibility of sub-classification within SCs and STs.
